第5730章 手中激战（第1页）
水下一道虚影快速游过来，紧跟着一张大嘴直奔林昆吞来，锋利的獠牙在水里散发着寒光，如同能将钢筋铁骨咬碎一般。
林昆只在水面上换了一小口气，就快速潜入水中，他一只手抓住鲨鱼的鼻子，另一只手抓住鲨鱼的下巴，强行不让鲨鱼将嘴合上。
这头大鲨鱼至少有三岁，体型庞大，力量更是说不出的大，林昆很快就支撑不住。
与此同时，大鲨鱼用力一甩头，直接将林昆在水底甩出去老远，林坤整个人在水里不断翻滚，激起一大层气泡翻涌。
他的手在流血，左手掌被鲨鱼的牙齿洞穿。
这时候顾不上疼痛，也没有时间去查看，手指头是不是掉了，迎面大鲨鱼又冲过来。
林昆利用腰腹力量，强行在水里稳住身形，同时将左手的鬼畜换到右手。
此刻在潜水层，借着外面的阳光可以看清大鲨鱼的模样，它来势极快，嘴巴里的牙齿锋利如同一把把匕首，激起一大片水泡和浪花，奔着林昆胸前咬下来。
这时，强行稳住身形与鲨鱼正面相对的，林昆不再躲闪脸上也没有丝毫畏惧，眼神中闪烁过一道冷光，嘴角微微上扬，一股子冰冷的杀意，以他为中心散发开来。
整个水层的温度仿佛一瞬间都随之下降。
马上就要冲到近前的大鲨鱼，忽然间仿佛察觉到危险，强行想要止住它庞大的身躯。
这一切出自于动物的本能，在察觉到危险时，这些生存在野外的动物都会第一时间闪躲。
然而对于这条大鲨鱼而言，他这一鼓作气，实在冲的太快，身形是止不住了。
水底一片白色气泡翻涌，林昆猛一挥手中的黑鬼畜，通体乌黑的三棱军刺直接扎进鲨鱼的左眼，这一刀不仅仅是扎进左眼，林昆出手后根本就没有留后手，三棱军刺继续向前，直到刺穿鲨鱼的脑子。
剧烈的疼痛令鲨鱼更是狂躁起来，脑子被刺穿后，它更是发起最后的拼命挣扎，一边疯狂扭动身体，一边挣扎着到处乱窜。
林昆想要赶紧拔出黑鬼畜，这鲨鱼拼命挣扎不断甩头，他也被在水里甩来甩去。
松开手可以自救，可是这样的黑鬼畜不一定被这家伙带到哪儿去，林昆只能咬牙坚持。
本以为这鲨鱼被刺中脑子之后，很快就会死亡，只要再坚持一会儿就可以了。
可林昆这一坚持就是10多分钟，整个人在水里被甩得晕头转向，嘴里更是呛了好几口水，海水冲进肺部，又是一阵撕裂的疼，他差一点直接闭上眼睛昏死过去。
又不知道过了多久，大鲨鱼终于停下，林坤这是感觉自己快要窒息而死。
他用尽身体的最后一丝力气将黑鬼处拔出来，然后有手脚并用浮上水面。
这一刻他不想太多了，再不呼吸新鲜空气，他真的会死，所以也不再害怕，是否会被全世界人发现他还活着。
林昆终于冲出水面，大口呼吸的新鲜空气，等到他意识稍微稳定下来，胸口因窒息而憋闷，如同被大石头压住一般的感觉退去了。
他用手抹了一把脸，然后被周围的一切惊住了，四周海面一片静悄悄的，似乎早就离开刚才战斗的地方，在正前方有一个小岛。
他不知道岛上有什么，但知道如果再不上岸，他一定会死的很惨，因为身后的海面上出现了一大排鲨鱼鳍
这些鲨鱼鳍如同快艇一般，正在迅速靠近。
刚才被他干掉的大鲨鱼流了很多血，是这股子血腥味儿吸引来了这些鲨鱼。
海里的鲨鱼对鲜血的味道是最敏感，距离几里地都能闻得到。
刚才对上一条大鲨鱼，他尚可凭借自己残存的体力拼上一拼，可现在紧跟着而来的至少是十条鲨鱼，在陆地上他一个打一百个不成问题，在这里是海底，是人家的主场。
林昆半秒钟都没有犹豫，激发出身体所有潜能，向迎面的小岛快速游去……
林昆感觉从来没这么刺激过，他一个人在前面疯狂游着，后面一大群鲨鱼追逐。
在浩瀚大海中，人类无疑是最渺小的。

Chapter 5730 Fierce battle in hands (page 1)
A shadow swam quickly under the water, followed by a big mouth and went straight to Lin Kun to swallow it. The sharp fangs radiated cold light in the water, as if they could bite steel and iron bones into pieces.
Lin Kun only took a short breath on the surface, and then quickly dived into the water. He grabbed the shark's nose with one hand and the shark's chin with the other hand, forcing the shark to not close its mouth.
This big shark was at least three years old. It was huge in size and indescribably powerful. Lin Kun soon couldn't support it.
At the same time, the big shark shook its head hard and threw Lin Kun far away under the water. Lin Kun's whole body kept rolling in the water, causing a large layer of bubbles to bubble up.
His hand was bleeding and the left palm was pierced by the shark's teeth.
At this time, I couldn't care about the pain, and I didn't have time to check if my finger had fallen off. The big shark rushed towards me again.
Lin Kun used the strength of his waist and abdomen to forcefully stabilize his body in the water, and at the same time, he switched the ghost from his left hand to his right hand.
At this moment in the diving layer, you can clearly see the appearance of the big shark through the sunlight outside. It came very fast, and the teeth in its mouth were as sharp as daggers. It stirred up a large amount of bubbles and spray, and rushed to bite Lin Kun's chest.
At this time, Lin Kun forcibly stabilized his body and faced the shark head-on. Lin Kun no longer dodges and showed no fear on his face. A cold light flashed in his eyes, the corners of his mouth raised slightly, and a cold killing intent spread out with him as the center.
The temperature of the entire water layer seemed to drop instantly.
The big shark that was about to rush forward suddenly seemed to sense the danger and tried to stop its huge body.
All this comes from animal instinct. When they sense danger, these animals living in the wild will dodge immediately.
However, for this big shark, he rushed too fast with all his strength and couldn't stop himself.
A sheet of white bubbles surged under the water. Lin Kun swung the black devil in his hand, and the three-edged black spur directly pierced the shark's left eye. This knife not only pierced the left eye, but Lin Kun did not leave a backhand after taking action. The three-edged spur continued forward until it pierced the shark's brain.
The severe pain made the shark even more frantic. After its brain was pierced, it launched a final desperate struggle, twisting its body crazily and struggling around.
Lin Kun wanted to pull out the black ghost beast quickly, but the shark struggled desperately and kept shaking its head, and he was also tossed around in the water.
He could save himself by letting go, but such a nigger might not be taken anywhere by this guy. Lin Kun could only grit his teeth and persist.
I thought that after the shark was stabbed in the brain, it would die soon, as long as it persisted for a while.
But Lin Kun persisted for more than 10 minutes. He was thrown into the water so dizzy that he choked several times. The seawater rushed into his lungs and there was another burst of tearing pain. He almost closed his eyes and passed out.
I don’t know how long it took, but the big shark finally stopped. Lin Kun felt like he was about to suffocate to death.
He used the last bit of strength in his body to pull out the nigga, and then used his hands and feet to float to the surface.
He didn't think too much at this moment. If he didn't breathe fresh air, he would really die, so he was no longer afraid of whether the whole world would discover that he was still alive.
Lin Kun finally broke out of the water and took a big breath of fresh air. When his consciousness stabilized slightly, the feeling of suffocation in his chest, as if he was being pressed by a big stone, receded.
He wiped his face with his hands, and then was shocked by everything around him. The sea around him was quiet. It seemed that he had left the place where he was fighting a long time ago. There was a small island directly in front of him.
He didn't know what was on the island, but he knew that if he didn't go ashore, he would die miserably because a large row of shark fins appeared on the sea behind him.
These shark fins are approaching quickly like speedboats.
The big shark he killed just now bled a lot, and it was the smell of blood that attracted these sharks.
Sharks in the sea are most sensitive to the smell of blood and can smell it from miles away.
When he faced a big shark just now, he could still put up a fight with his remaining physical strength, but now there were at least ten sharks following him. On land, he could fight a hundred of them without any problem. This was the bottom of the sea, his home field.
Lin Kun didn't hesitate for half a second, unleashed all his body's potential, and swam quickly towards the oncoming island...
Lin Kun had never felt so excited. He was swimming crazily in front of him, and was chased by a large group of sharks behind him.
In the vast sea, human beings are undoubtedly the smallest.
